title: B-tree nullable and non-null page reference release

scope.rationale: releasePageNotNull validates a B-tree page wrapper and releases one Pager reference, while releasePage provides the nullable no-op wrapper.

external_source_responsibilities: Pager/cache owner maintains reference count and wrapper/data identity
dependencies.caller_closure: Both complete release helpers are assigned and releasePageOne delegates to the same validated non-null owner.

contracts.ownership: Consumes one borrowed page reference when non-null; Shared retains cached page ownership.
contracts.state_and_results: Non-null page reference count decrements exactly once after invariant assertions. Null input is an exact no-op.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns B-tree synchronization. No callbacks or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Invalid non-null reference state violates assertions; valid release is infallible.

representation_differences: Zig Page combines the source MemPage wrapper and bounded Pager reference observation; data/wrapper identity is structural rather than separate pDbPage/pExtra pointers.

oracle.protocol: Acquire a page reference, invoke nullable release with null and observe no change, then release non-null and observe one decrement.
oracle.normalization: Wrapper/Pager pointer assertions normalize to typed Zig Page structural identity.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; caller owns B-tree synchronization.
assurance.malformed_input: Zero references or empty data violate assertions.
assurance.continuation: Valid release leaves cache ownership and remaining references usable.

integration.native_call_path: Cursor movement, lookup, overflow traversal, integrity, and unused-page paths release through releasePageOne/non-null owner.

independent_review.notes: Requires Pager-reference differential, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Trace exact Pager reference and cache retention across nullable/non-null/page-one releases.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/btree.c:2408-2445 and Pager unref ownership were reviewed
src/core/internal/btree_core.zig Page fields, get/release paths, cursor ownership, and tests were reviewed
assertions_branches_cleanup: All seven generated blocks are assigned
Non-null release consumes exactly one reference and does not free cache owner
upstream_tests: Upstream B-tree cursor, Pager reference, balance, overflow, and corruption tests exercise release
